description: Department of Local Government - Northern Province - Notify the meeting of the Delft Pradeshiya Sabha for the election of Vice Chairman
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the convening of a meeting for the election of the Vice Chairman of Delft Pradeshiya Sabha under the Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act. It specifically deals with electoral processes at the local government level, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral matters including election meetings and procedures.
